soil: Well-drained loam or clay loam, pH 6.0-7.5
water_requirement: 4-6 irrigations. Critical stages: Crown Root Initiation (CRI at 20-25 days), Tillering (40-45 days), Jointing (60-65 days), Flowering (80-85 days), Milking (100-105 days), Dough stage (115-120 days). CRI irrigation is most critical.
fertilizer_general: 120 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 40 kg K2O per hectare. Apply full P & K plus 1/3rd N as basal at sowing. Top dress remaining N in two equal splits at 1st (CRI) and 2nd (Tillering) irrigations. Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (21%) in zinc-deficient soils.
common_issues: Yellow rust (Puccinia striiformis) appearing as bright yellow pustules in stripes on leaves; Zinc deficiency (khaira-like chlorosis on 3rd/4th leaf from top); Phalaris minor (Gulli Danda) weed infestation; Termite damage in sandy soils.

soil: Clayey or heavy loam soils capable of holding standing water, pH 5.5-7.5
water_requirement: Needs shallow standing water (2-3 cm) during first 10 days of seedling establishment and during flowering. Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) saves 25-30% water during vegetative tillering without yield reduction. Drain 10 days before harvest.
fertilizer_general: 120 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 40 kg K2O per hectare. Mandatory 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate (21%) basal to prevent Khaira disease. Top dress Urea in 3 splits (basal, active tillering 20-25 DAT, panicle initiation 40-45 DAT).
common_issues: Leaf & Neck Blast (Pyricularia oryzae) showing spindle-shaped spots with grey centers; Sheath Blight (Rhizoctonia solani); Brown Plant Hopper (BPH) causing hopper burn; Khaira disease (zinc deficiency); Yellow Stem Borer.

soil: Sandy loam to loamy soil, good drainage, pH 6.5-7.5
water_requirement: 2-3 light irrigations. 1st at rosette/branching (30-35 days), 2nd at siliquae/pod development (60-65 days). Avoid heavy flooding or waterlogging.
fertilizer_general: 80 kg N : 40 kg P2O5 : 40 kg K2O per hectare. Crucially requires 20-30 kg/ha Sulphur (via 150-200 kg/ha Agricultural Gypsum or SSP) to synthesize oil and boost yield by 15-20%.
common_issues: Mustard aphid (Lipaphis erysimi) sucking sap from flowering buds and pods (spray late afternoon to protect honeybees); White rust (Albugo candida) causing white pustules on leaf underside and floral staghead malformation.

soil: Deep, fertile loam or silt loam, rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5. Extremely susceptible to waterlogging.
water_requirement: Requires 500-600 mm water. Critical stages: Knee-high (30-35 DAS), Tasseling (50-55 DAS), and Silking (55-65 DAS). Waterlogging for even 24 hours causes root asphyxiation and severe yellowing.
fertilizer_general: 120 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 50 kg K2O per hectare. Split nitrogen: 20% basal, 50% at knee-high stage with earthing up, 30% at tasseling. Apply 25 kg/ha Zinc Sulphate to prevent White Bud.
common_issues: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) damaging central whorl leaves with pinholes and sawdust-like frass; Stem Borer (Chilo partellus); Maydis leaf blight.

season: Rabi (Oct 15 - Nov 5 main planting, Jan-Feb harvest)
soil: Loose, friable sandy loam rich in organic matter, pH 5.2-6.5 (inhibits common scab)
water_requirement: Frequent light furrow irrigations (every 7-10 days). Never allow furrow water to overtop ridge crests. Stop irrigation 10-12 days before harvest to allow skin curing and dehaulming.
fertilizer_general: 150-180 kg N : 80-100 kg P2O5 : 100-120 kg K2O per hectare. High Potassium is vital for tuber bulking, starch formation, and cold storage shelf-life. SOP preferred for seed/processing potatoes.
common_issues: Late blight (Phytophthora infestans) causing water-soaked dark lesions during foggy, cool, humid weather; Early blight causing concentric target rings; Tuber greening from exposed ridges; Black scurf.

soil: Well-drained sandy loam or loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.0
water_requirement: Drip or light furrow irrigation every 5-8 days. Avoid moisture fluctuations during fruit ripening to prevent fruit cracking (splitting).
fertilizer_general: 120-150 kg N : 80-100 kg P2O5 : 100-120 kg K2O per hectare. Requires Calcium and Boron foliar sprays (0.5% Calcium Nitrate + 0.1% Boron) to prevent Blossom End Rot.
common_issues: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by Whiteflies (Bemisia tabaci); Blossom End Rot (black sunken dry scar on bottom); Tomato Fruit Borer (Helicoverpa armigera); Early Blight.

season: Rabi (Late Oct - Mid Nov sowing, Mar-Apr harvest)
soil: Mar (deep black), Kabar (clayey), Parwa (loam) soils of Bundelkhand, pH 6.5-8.0
water_requirement: Primarily rainfed. 1-2 life-saving sprinkler irrigations if needed: 1st at pre-flowering branching (40-45 DAS) and 2nd at pod filling (70-75 DAS). Strictly avoid irrigation at peak flowering.
fertilizer_general: 20 kg N : 50 kg P2O5 : 20 kg K2O : 20 kg S per hectare. Mandatory dual seed inoculation with Rhizobium and PSB. Single Super Phosphate (SSP) is preferred for phosphorus and sulphur.
common_issues: Fusarium wilt (internal black xylem streak); Dry root rot (Rhizoctonia bataticola) under post-flowering heat and drought; Gram pod borer (Helicoverpa armigera); Pulse beetle in storage.

season: Rabi (Late Oct - Mid Nov sowing, Mar-Apr harvest)
soil: Well-drained loam, clay loam, and alluvial soils, pH 6.0-7.5
water_requirement: 1-2 light irrigations. 1st at 30-35 DAS (vegetative) and 2nd at pod development (65-70 DAS). Avoid water stagnation.
fertilizer_general: 20 kg N : 40 kg P2O5 : 20 kg K2O : 20 kg S per hectare. Inoculate seed with Rhizobium leguminosarum and PSB.
common_issues: Rust (Uromyces viciae-fabae); Fusarium wilt; Collar rot; Aphids (Aphis craccivora).

soil: Deep fertile alluvial loam and clay loam with good drainage, pH 6.5-7.8
water_requirement: Requires 1500-2000 mm water across lifecycle (7-10 irrigations in summer at 10-12 day intervals; 3-4 in winter). Trench planting saves 30% water.
fertilizer_general: 180-200 kg N : 60-80 kg P2O5 : 60 kg K2O per hectare (Plant crop); 220-250 kg N/ha for Ratoon crop. Apply Zinc Sulphate 25 kg/ha basal.
common_issues: Red Rot (Colletotrichum falcatum) breakdown in Co-0238 (replace with Co-15023, Co-0118); Top borer; Early shoot borer; White grub; Trash burning damage.

season: Rabi (Oct-Nov nursery, Dec-Jan transplant) & Kharif (June nursery, Aug transplant)
soil: Friable sandy loam or silt loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.5
water_requirement: Frequent light irrigations every 7-10 days. Stop irrigation 10-15 days before harvest when 20-25% neck-fall begins to prevent bulb rot.
fertilizer_general: 100-120 kg N : 50-60 kg P2O5 : 80-100 kg K2O : 30-40 kg S per hectare. Stop nitrogen application after 60 DAT to avoid thick neck bulbs.
common_issues: Onion thrips (Thrips tabaci) causing silvery leaf curling; Purple blotch (Alternaria porri); Damping off in nursery; Black mold (Aspergillus niger) in storage.

season: Kharif (20 June - 10 July sowing, Sep-Oct harvest)
soil: Medium to deep black soils (Mar/Kabar) and clay loam, pH 6.5-7.5
water_requirement: Rainfed crop. Planting on Broad Bed Furrows (BBF 120 cm) prevents waterlogging during heavy rains and conserves moisture during terminal dry spells.
fertilizer_general: 20-25 kg N (starter) : 60 kg P2O5 (via SSP) : 40 kg K2O : 20 kg S per hectare. Mandatory Bradyrhizobium japonicum + PSB seed inoculation.
common_issues: Yellow Mosaic Virus (YMV) transmitted by whiteflies; Girdle beetle (Obereopsis brevis) cutting petiole rings; Semilooper; Charcoal rot; Seed shattering.

soil: Light well-drained sandy loam rich in calcium, pH 6.0-7.5
water_requirement: Requires moist soil especially during flowering and peg entry (pegging). 2-3 protective irrigations during dry spells. Summer crop requires 4-6 sprinkler irrigations.
fertilizer_general: 20 kg N : 40-50 kg P2O5 : 40 kg K2O per hectare. Crucially requires 250-400 kg/ha Agricultural Gypsum at pegging stage (40-45 DAS) to prevent empty pods (Pops).
common_issues: White grub (Holotrichia consanguinea); Collar rot (Aspergillus niger); Tikka leaf spot (Cercospora); Aflatoxin mold contamination in post-harvest storage.

season: Kharif (June 15 - July 10 sowing, Mar-Apr harvest for long duration Bahar/NDA-1)
soil: Deep well-drained alluvial loam or sandy loam without water stagnation, pH 6.5-7.5
water_requirement: Deep taproot enables high drought tolerance. Mandatory ridge planting to prevent water stagnation. 1-2 life-saving irrigations at pod development if post-monsoon fails.
fertilizer_general: 20-25 kg N : 50-60 kg P2O5 : 30 kg K2O : 20 kg S per hectare. Inoculate seed with Rhizobium and PSB.
common_issues: Phytophthora stem blight in waterlogged fields; Pod fly (Melanagromyza obtusa) destroying seeds inside pods; Gram pod borer; Sterility Mosaic Disease (SMD).

soil: Well-drained sandy loam or clay loam rich in organic matter, pH 6.0-7.0
water_requirement: Drip or light furrow irrigation every 5-7 days. Silver-black plastic mulch conserves 40% water and suppresses weeds.
fertilizer_general: 120-150 kg N : 60-80 kg P2O5 : 80-100 kg K2O per hectare applied in weekly fertigation splits. Calcium Nitrate and Boron foliar sprays prevent blossom drop.
common_issues: Murda leaf curl complex (Thrips causing upward curling, Yellow mites causing downward curling, Whitefly viral transmission); Anthracnose fruit rot and dieback.

soil: Deep rich alluvial loam or clay loam with exceptional drainage, pH 6.5-7.5
water_requirement: High water requirement (1800-2200 mm/year). Drip irrigation (15-20 liters/plant/day in summer; 8-10 liters in winter) ensures high bunch weight.
fertilizer_general: 200 g N : 60 g P2O5 : 300 g K2O per plant per year applied in weekly drip fertigation splits. High potassium is vital for 28-35 kg bunch weights.
common_issues: Sigatoka leaf spot (Pseudocercospora musae); Panama wilt TR4; Pseudostem borer; Excessive side suckers; Bunch sunburn and thrips scarring (prevented by bunch bagging).

season: Kharif / Spring (15 April - 15 May sowing, Oct-Nov picking)
soil: Deep fertile alluvial loam with good drainage, pH 7.0-8.2
water_requirement: 4-5 irrigations. Critical stages: Flowering, squaring, and boll development. Ridge-furrow planting prevents waterlogging during monsoon.
fertilizer_general: 120-150 kg N : 60 kg P2O5 : 60 kg K2O per hectare. Split N into 3 doses. Foliar spray 1% Magnesium Sulphate at 60 and 80 DAS prevents leaf reddening.
common_issues: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) transmitting Cotton Leaf Curl Virus Disease (CLCuD); Pink bollworm (Pectinophora gossypiella); Rosette flowers; Non-Bt refuge compliance.
